title: The while Loop

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **The while Loop** as part of **Decision-Making and Loops**. Choose a loop form based on when the condition is checked and what is iterated; ranges and collection iteration make bounds and state changes explicit. Use the subtopics—Loop Conditions, Avoiding Infinite Loops, State Changes During Iteration—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.
